character: A halfling man in his forties, about four feet tall, short and stocky, broad through the shoulders. Tidy brown curls, neatly groomed, clean-shaven. A practised courteous smile that does not reach his eyes, tight skin at the corners, dark circles beneath. Hands held very still, clasped in front of him
wardrobe: a long deep wine-red coat of figured silk brocade with a subtle woven pattern, gold-thread edging at the cuffs and collar, polished brass buttons, over an embroidered waistcoat in deep rose silk and a soft cream cravat pinned with a small gold pin. Every piece immaculate and slightly too formal for the wearer

full.framing: Full body standing portrait of a short stocky halfling, three-quarter view, hands clasped neatly in front of him, composed and courteous.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, composed polite expression, a practised courteous smile that does not reach the eyes, head and upper chest filling the frame.

scene.framing: A short halfling merchant standing behind a cloth merchant's counter stacked with bolts of fabric, a length of deep rose silk framed on the wall behind him, composed and courteous, one hand resting near the silk square in his pocket.
